A picture of Zelda and the five Champions, taken after the inauguration ceremony at Hyrule Castle. Kass gifted you this precious item after completing The Champions' Ballad.|Inventory|BotW}} The Picture of the Champions goes unnamed in {{TotK}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Picture of the Champions is a Key Item in the "[[EX The Champions' Ballad]]" [[Main Quest]], which is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack. It is given to [[Link]] by [[Kass]] after the latter sings "[[The Champions' Ballad (Song)|The Champions' Ballad]]". The Picture of the Champions was taken with the [[Sheikah Slate]] after the inauguration ceremony for the [[Champions]] at [[Hyrule Castle]]. After hearing of the Sheikah Slate's ability to capture realistic photographs from [[Urbosa]], [[Mipha]] suggests that [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] and the five Champions have their picture taken to commemorate the event.{{Cite|The princess showed me something strange recently. Somehow, it can create true-to-life images.|Urbosa|BotW}}
{{Cite|Oh, wow. I would love to see it. Um, Princess... May I ask a special favor of you?|Mipha|BotW}} After some preparation, [[Purah]] snaps a [[Picture]] of the group.{{Cite|All right! This spot should work nicely. Keep your eyes on the Sheikah Slate, everyone! Daruk, can you crouch down a bit? You're as big as Death Mountain. What's with the glum face, Princess? Gimme a big smile! Revali, move your tail closer to the group.|Purah|BotW}}
{{Cite|Ugh, fine.|Revali|BotW}}
{{Cite|Mipha, you look so tense. Deep breaths, OK?|Purah|BotW}}
{{Cite|Right!|Mipha|BotW}}
{{Cite|Stay just like that! Here we go! Smiiiile... Click, snap! ♪|Purah|BotW}} However, [[Daruk]] forcefully pulls the group together at the last moment, immortalizing a comical scene. At some point, the Picture of the Champions was printed and fell into the hands of Kass's teacher, the [[Court Poet]], who kept it safe. Kass later discovered it while attempting to finish "The Champions' Ballad".{{Cite|By the way, I found this when I was looking through my teacher's notes. I was thinking...you should be the one to keep it. Your courageous heart reminds me of the indomitable spirit of the Champions. I know you'll treasure it.|Kass|BotW}} He gifts it to Link atop the [[Great Plateau]] after performing his late teacher's completed song with the understanding that Link would treasure it most. If the "[[Hylian Homeowner]]" [[Side Quest]] has been completed, Link can hang the Picture of the Champions on the wall next to his [[Bed]] at [[Link's House|his House]] in [[Hateno Village]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Link Picture of the Champions.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link hanging up the Picture of the Champions ==See Also== {{See Also| * Champion * Picture }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Pictures |items= BotW |key-items= BotW |objects= TotK }}
